checks.name: ctl_om9_no_cross_identity_wipe_full_spec
checks.detail: Exhaustive CTL closure against the full spec (11 given types, 26 operations) did not complete within 280s wall time at DEFAULT_SETSIZE 2 or 3 -- exceeded 300,000 discovered states and still climbing. This is a scale characteristic of the base+biff combined lifecycle model, not specific to the planSet indexing change. See claude-code-biff-om9-globalwipe.report.json for the exhaustively-verified before/after pair on the formal projection harness.

checks.name: ctl_om9_no_cross_identity_wipe_minimal_harness
checks.detail: Verified TRUE, exhaustively, over 9 total reachable states in under 30ms, against a harness identical to claude-code-biff-om9-globalwipe.tex except StartSession's postcondition restored to this file's own override-based fix. The corresponding pre-fix variant (claude-code-biff-om9-globalwipe.tex itself) proves the formula FALSE with the biff-om9 counterexample -- see its own .report.json.

notes: planSet, planSource re-indexed from flat ZBOOL/finset(PlanSource) to AGENTID-partial-functions per design mission m-2026-08-09-018 Sec 6 (biff-ar1/biff-om9).

planWiped is a free ghost observer (not a State invariant) checked via explicit CTL formula, matching nats-relay.tex's spuriousTeardown idiom -- see Section 'Identity-Indexed Plan State' for the errata explaining why an earlier draft's pinned-invariant approach was unsound.

StartSession's precondition was widened from 'sessionPhase = spInactive' to 'sessionPhase = spInactive OR sessionPhase = spEnded', and the sessionId cardinality invariant corrected to exempt spEnded as well as spInactive -- both were necessary base-model errata fixes for a second session's StartSession to be reachable at all (EndSession was previously unfireable: its own postcondition sessionId' = empty directly contradicted the un-corrected invariant 'sessionPhase =/= spInactive => #sessionId = 1' at spEnded).
StartSubagent added (design Sec 6, optional-but-recommended), formalizing the SubagentStart hook capture for in-process subagents.
